steps.name: create .env and start temporary Postgres and Keycloak
steps.cmd: {python} -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess; Path('.env').write_bytes(Path('.env.example').read_bytes()); raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(['docker','compose','-p','{project}','up','-d','--wait']))"

steps.name: install the packages into a throwaway folder
token rules offline
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import os, subprocess, sys; sys.exit(subprocess.call([sys.executable, 'scripts/token_rules.py'], env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='.deps')))"
expect_contains: ok    signed with another key                      rejected: InvalidSignatureError: Signature verification failed
ok    algorithm none (no signature)                rejected: algorithm 'none' is not allowed
ok    HS256 signed with the public key             rejected: algorithm 'HS256' is not allowed

steps.name: start the API on the host
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.deps'); import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('app.main:app', port=8000)"

steps.name: a forged admin token is refused
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import os, subprocess, sys; env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='.deps'); token = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'scripts/forge_token.py'], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(); subprocess.call([sys.executable, 'scripts/call.py', 'GET', '/v1/audit-log', '--token', token])"
